uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:mango.text: This is Mango. She's a spotted rose snapper.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:roly.text: And this is Roly. She's an isopod — a crustacean, more shrimp than insect.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:arrive.text: Roly arrived as a speck, and slipped in through Mango's gills.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:two.text: Two of them found Mango. Every one of them starts out male.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:change.text: Roly grew faster. And then Roly changed.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:female.text: She became female. And the female gets the mouth.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:tongue1.text: Now, a fish's tongue is nothing like yours. It's a bony pad. No muscle of its own.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:tongue2.text: Its job is to press food against the teeth in the roof of the mouth.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:grip.text: Roly clamps onto the base of Mango's tongue, and drinks the blood that feeds it.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:fade.text: Without that blood, the tongue slowly shrinks... and falls away.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:place.text: She doesn't eat it. She takes its place.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:feet.text: Fourteen hooked feet, holding on to what's left.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:eats.text: And Mango? Mango goes back to eating.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:proof.text: When scientists opened up fish like Mango, they found the teeth above had scuffed Roly's back.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:press.text: Mango had been pressing her food against her.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:hedge1.text: Is that bad for Mango? Nobody's sure.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:hedge2.text: But a fish with Roly may feed better than a fish with no tongue at all.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:pouch.text: Under Roly's belly, a pouch. More than four hundred eggs.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:father.text: And the father? The other one who found Mango. Still back on the gills.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:hatch.text: One day the pouch opens. Hundreds of specks swim out, each one looking for a mouth.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:stay.text: And Mango will carry Roly for the rest of her life.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:button.text: She still has a tongue. It just isn't hers.
